tools.name: cve_priority
tools.description: Patch-priority verdict for 1-20 CVE IDs with evidence: CISA KEV status (date added, due date, ransomware use), FIRST EPSS probability, CVSS (CNA or CISA-ADP), CISA SSVC exploitation/automatable/impact, vendor, product and links. Sorted most urgent first.

tools.name: kev_recent
tools.description: CVEs added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog in the last N days, newest first, with due date, ransomware use and EPSS. Optional vendor/product text filter.

tools.name: epss_watchlist
tools.description: The highest-EPSS CVEs (most likely to be exploited in 30 days) that are not in CISA KEV yet. Defaults to this year's CVE IDs.
